verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions automations are defined "right in your repository" (github-docs-38), which implies they are versioned with the code. GitHub's documented pull request workflow for creating and reviewing code (github-docs-69, github-docs-61) gives a review path for changes, including agent-made changes delivered as PRs (github-docs-26). However, the evidence never explicitly says workflow files are versioned or reviewed this way, and never documents rollback of automations. missing for 10: explicit documentation that workflow/automation definitions are versioned and reviewed via PRs, any documented rollback/revert mechanism for automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
